2014_spells.summon-beast.description: You call forth a beast spirit. It manifests in an unoccupied space that you can see within range. This corporeal form uses the Beast Spirit stat block. When you cast the spell, choose an air, land, or water spirit. The creature resembles a beast of that type, which determines certain traits in the creature's stat block. The creature disappears when it drops to 0 hit points or when the spell ends. The creature is an ally to you and your companions. In combat, the creature shares your initiative count, but it takes its turn immediately after yours. It obeys your verbal commands (no action required by you). If you issue none, it takes the Dodge action and uses its move to avoid danger.
2014_spells.summon-beast.effectSummary: Move a creature or object a short distance
2014_spells.summon-beast.fullDescription: Using 1 action, when you cast the spell, choose an air, land, or water spirit. The creature disappears when it drops to 0 hit points or when the spell ends; In combat, the creature shares your initiative count, but it takes its turn immediately after yours; When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the creature's statistics change as described in the spell's description. The creature disappears when it drops to 0 hit points or when the spell ends; you must concentrate, and the effect ends if your concentration ends.
